test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends K, L, M, N, O and P are sitting in two rows; both the rows are facing north. Four friends are in the first row, whereas two friends are in the second row. L is sitting between O and P. M is just behind O. N is just behind L. There is nobody sitting behind K and P, who are sitting at the corners. Who among them are sitting in the first row?
solution:
Total six friends facing north sitting in two rows:- K, L, M, N, O and P

1) L is sitting between O and P.

2) M is just behind O. N is just behind L.
